prompt:
Use case: compositing and style-transfer.
Primary request: Revise DDDumpling's promotional banner to include the four Adventure lands and the Survival mode rainbow game-over skit, and make its main dumpling visibly match the game's actual graphic style.
Input images: Image 1 is the banner edit target with Slime, Octopulse, Fly Agaric and the collectible hexagon faces. Image 2 is a freshly rendered board from the game itself: the TOP golden dumpling is the EXACT new main hero design to copy; the other four figures are green Slime hills, faceted purple crystal towers, sea kelp and bubbles, and the pink mushroom land emblem. Image 3 is the exact Survival game-over rainbow curl skit, with a tiny cream companion riding a rainbow ribbon. Images 2 and 3 are strict art/identity references. Never copy their portrait board layout or game interface.
MAIN DUMPLING CORRECTION: Replace the falsely realistic glossy 3D golden dumpling in Image 1 with the flat 2D golden character from the top of Image 2. Preserve its deliberately slightly angular rounded bao silhouette, short pinched tip and three simple pleat strokes, solid pale golden fill, very simple chunky dark-plum inverted-V smiling eyes, W mouth, solid coral-red round cheeks and just one simple oval highlight on the upper left. No rendered volumetric lighting, no smooth puffed 3D shading, no photoreal food texture, no glass or gummy material. It should look like an enlarged original game sprite. Keep the main hero wholly inside x40%-60%,y23%-54% of the full canvas, centered at x50%,y38%; do not enlarge it.
GRAPHICAL STYLE: bring the whole illustration toward the game's distinctive flat 2D geometry, simple fills, small cel-shadow areas, soft plum outlines and pastel colors. Keep the bosses' exact identities and distinctive anatomy. Retain Slime on the left, pink Octopulse on the right, red spotted Fly Agaric below-left, and the cute hexagon friends. Keep the delightful arcade composition, but reduce the faux glossy 3D, excessive neon bloom, and photographic flare.
ADD LANDS: introduce four coherent small scenery regions along the lower half and outer sides, integrated into the scene rather than pasted inside boxes: soft overlapping green goo hills below Slime; clustered simple faceted lavender crystal towers behind and around the left-middle; sea-blue kelp ribbons and bubble rings around Octopulse; several pastel pink/purple spotted mushroom land forms near Fly Agaric. These must be recognizably like the actual game art in Image 2. No invented castles, mountains, houses or forest trees. Keep terrain secondary to faces, don't obscure the hero or bosses. Use simple low-contrast plum cloud shapes for breathing room.
ADD SURVIVAL GAME-OVER RAINBOW: weave a clearly visible seven-band pastel rainbow ribbon across the lower middle into the lower-right, curling upward into a C-shaped loop like Image 3. Include the small cream companion riding inside the curl with tiny rounded hands, dark-plum face, pink cheeks and rounded crimped top. Keep it a small supporting vignette below/right of the hero, not a second large hero. In the surrounding right-side background use a few subdued vertically descending rainbow bands with rounded tips, referencing Survival's actual scene, so it is visibly this mode. Preserve the pink, peach, yellow, mint, cyan, lavender, lilac ordering and distinct flat bands. No text GAME OVER or SURVIVAL, the visual motif suffices.
Composition: landscape16:9, full-bleed dark plum background with a few tasteful geometric hexagons, clear central golden hero, bosses on either side, land scenery under them and Survival rainbow vignette below-right. Maintain clean separation and readability on a small mobile card. Full golden dumpling and its face fit in Apple's tight central upper safe region. Supporting scenery is allowed to crop at device edges.
Opaque PNG, highest available resolution. No words, logos, labels, scores, healthbars, UI, phone frame, template guides, borders, awards or watermarks. No realistic food or plastic 3D characters. Do not redesign actual boss identities.
